value: This article introduces Easels, a feature within Arc for macOS described as "super-powered whiteboards" designed for collecting and organizing ideas while browsing the internet. It details how users can create new Easels, capture web snippets, draw, write, or add images to them. The guide also covers where to locate Easels within Arc and outlines sharing capabilities, including exporting to PNGs or sharing via links. Notably, while Easels are viewable on any web browser and in Arc Search for iOS, editing functionality is exclusive to Arc for macOS.
